class.name: OcgGCMakeellipse2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for ellipses in the plane. The result is a `Geom2d_Ellipse`. A `GC_MakeEllipse2d` object provides a framework for: - defining the construction parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the construction status and the resulting ellipse via `Value()`.
class.description: ! This class implements construction algorithms for ellipses in the plane. ! The result is a `Geom2d_Ellipse`. ! A `GC_MakeEllipse2d` object provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction parameters; ! - running the construction algorithm; ! - querying the construction status and the resulting ellipse via `Value()`. ! @note Ellipse parameterization range is [0, 2*PI]. ! @note The X axis of the local coordinate system is the major axis, ! and the Y axis is the minor axis.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Creates an ellipse from a non-persistent one from package gp.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates an ellipse from a local coordinate system and radii.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates an ellipse from two apex points and center point.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates an ellipse from major axis placement and radii.
